summary: Frontend-only validation completed for language-flow split and chat crash-regression signals. /languages now behaves as multi-select skip-translation with grouped headings and checkbox rows; /message-language is single-select and shows full catalog by default (111 rows) including distinct variants. Chat route stayed stable in unauth preview soak, but the exact Asare Ben Chris crash path remains unverified without signed-in device access. MOCKED APIs: none.

integration_issues.flow: Asare Ben Chris real-conversation crash validation
integration_issues.issue: Could not run true end-to-end repro/fix validation because authenticated production contact/conversation access was not available in this automation run.
Console repeatedly logs Convex argument errors because useSafeConvexQuery is called with string 'skip' args instead of an object when signed out.

react_native_issues.issue: Non-blocking warnings persist (expo-notifications web listener support, expo-av deprecation, deprecated shadow/textShadow/pointerEvents style props).

action_items: Run signed-in native-device validation for exact contact flow: open Asare Ben Chris conversation and verify no shaky load/app close on Android.
Fix /languages unauth query call by passing object args and using enabled=false instead of string 'skip' to remove repeated Convex argument warnings.
After auth/device validation, confirm translation auto-run no longer causes repeated rerender/crash in real message stream.
critical_code_review_comments: `/app/frontend/app/languages.tsx` currently calls `useSafeConvexQuery(..., isAuthenticated ? {} : 'skip', ...)`; hook contract expects object args, which explains repeated console warnings.
`/app/frontend/app/chat/[conversationId].tsx` remains very large (>700 lines), increasing risk for side-effect regressions like translation-loop behavior and making RCA harder.
Code review confirms translation effect no longer depends on `translatedMessageMap`, reducing prior self-trigger loop risk.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Core language split requirements passed in preview: /languages grouped multi-select + default callout + checkbox rows; /message-language single-select with 111 default rows and preserved variants (zh vs zh-TW, pt vs pt-BR). Chat route remained stable for 7s soak without red-screen, but true Asare Ben Chris regression still blocked by missing authenticated real-data/device run.
rca_of_issue: Repro for warning: open /languages while signed out. Console shows `Convex query failed ... The arguments to a Convex function must be an object. Received: skip`. Root cause is passing string sentinel `skip` as args into `useSafeConvexQuery` instead of object args + `enabled=false` gating.
